major_cooldowns.name: Takedown
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Survival's primary cooldown: 20% damage and doubled auto-attack speed for only 8 sec, so enter it prepared, with 2 Tip of the Spear stacks from a Kill Command pressed right before it, or with 0 stacks if you run Twin Fangs, and press it again as a filler whenever it drifts off cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id 1250646, base cooldown 90s per the ability table; the guide notes 2 points of Savagery cut it to 60s.

major_cooldowns.name: Boomstick
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown with Tip of the Spear up, and on Sentinel only while the target has no Sentinel's Mark; with Lethal Calibration each Wildfire Bomb hit shaves 2 sec off it, up to 10 sec.

major_cooldowns.name: Flamefang Pitch
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast on cooldown in both single target and AoE; it does not need to be Tipped, so never spend a Tip of the Spear stack setting it up.

major_cooldowns.name: Moonlight Chakram
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On Sentinel it replaces the Takedown button for 15 sec after Takedown is pressed: throw it with Tip of the Spear up, early in the window, and never let it expire unused.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Sentinel-only button, not observed in the sampled Pack Leader parse; 1264949 is the castable 40 yd row, while the guide links the talent node 1264902. Cooldown is once per Takedown, so it is tracked at Takedown's 90s.

major_cooldowns.name: Algeth'ar Puzzle
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Pre-cast it about 2 sec before the pull, 3 sec if you are also pre-casting a bomb, and afterwards only fire it when Takedown is within 5 sec of coming up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: On-use trinket; zero casts is expected for any player not wearing it.

defensives.name: Aspect of the Turtle
defensives.usage_rule: Full immunity plus 30% damage reduction for 8 sec, but you cannot attack, so save it for a lethal hit you cannot otherwise survive.

defensives.name: Survival of the Fittest
defensives.usage_rule: 30% damage reduction for you and your pet on a short 6 sec window, so press it into a known raid hit rather than reactively.

defensives.name: Exhilaration
defensives.usage_rule: Instant heal for 30% of your health and a full heal for your pet; use it once you are actually low so none of it overheals.

defensives.name: Roar of Sacrifice
defensives.usage_rule: Cuts 15% of the damage taken by you or an ally for 10 sec at your pet's expense, so keep it for a targeted hit and not for sustained pet-killing damage.

rules.description: Tip of the Spear stays up between Kill Commands
rules.action: Every ability should be Tipped. Run Kill Command into 2 Tipped abilities and repeat, and press Kill Command whenever you are down to 1 stack or fewer so the buff never sits empty.

rules.description: Boomstick only with Tip of the Spear up
rules.action: Press Kill Command before Boomstick so the 3 sec channel is Tipped; on Sentinel also wait until Sentinel's Mark has fallen off the target.

rules.description: Takedown spent at max Tip of the Spear stacks
rules.action: Enter Takedown with 2 Tip of the Spear stacks, pressing Kill Command right before it to set them up without overcapping (0 stacks if you run Twin Fangs).

rules.description: Open Kill Command into Takedown, then Boomstick
rules.action: Pre-cast Wildfire Bomb about 1 sec before the pull, then Kill Command, potion and racials, Takedown, Wildfire Bomb, Kill Command, Boomstick, Kill Command. In AoE hold Takedown until the pack is stacked.

rules.description: Algeth'ar Puzzle Box lines up with Takedown
rules.action: Fire the trinket only when Takedown is ready or within 5 sec of coming up, and pre-cast it roughly 2 sec before the pull so its 20 sec of Mastery covers the opener window.

source_summary: Survival builds everything around Takedown, an 8 sec window of 20% extra damage entered with 2 Tip of the Spear stacks (or 0 with Twin Fangs) and fed by Kill Command, with potion, racials and on-use trinkets held for it. Boomstick, Wildfire Bomb and Flamefang Pitch go on cooldown around that window, and every ability except Flamefang Pitch and non-Swipe Raptor Strikes should be Tipped first. The hero talents split the tail of the priority: Pack Leader turns the first Kill Command inside Takedown into a placed Stampede line, while Sentinel replaces Takedown with a single Moonlight Chakram that must go out before the window ends.
